details.Scope and next action: Use provider-native usage events when controlling an explicit Codex thread. T3-provider-neutral attribution requires a supported T3 execution-to-provider usage interface; do not infer identities by time or mark complete without independent acceptance.

The installed T3 CLI thread show and exposed MCP read did not return provider session ID or usage for the test child. No public provider-neutral exact-run usage API has been proved in this session.
